title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Lesotho’s communication and advocacy efforts drove transformative progress in child rights through strategic policy influence, public awareness campaigns, and digital innovations. Key achievements included increased access to child protection services, improved immunization rates, and enhanced education equity, ensuring systemic change and reducing deprivations for children across Lesotho.;
